title: Implement command heartbeats and interruption recovery
description: Implement the provider-neutral heartbeat and lease-loss behavior for story plx-cc5f16. The worker must renew lifecycle ownership and broker delivery visibility while execution is active, propagate lost ownership cooperatively to the executor, fence stale mutations and acknowledgement, and remain deterministic under tests. Provider adapters, cancellation requests, deployment draining, and dashboard integration remain out of scope.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementation started on feature/command-worker-recovery. Scope is limited to provider-neutral automatic heartbeats, delivery-lease extension, rotated fencing tokens, cooperative ownership-loss propagation, and deterministic behavior specifications. Cancellation, draining, provider adapters, dashboard integration, and infrastructure remain separate tasks.
